title: AIOS Integration Framework v1 — constitutional invariants and owning tests
description: Every invariant id maps to exactly one owning test id, and no test id owns more than one invariant. Additional defence-in-depth tests may reference an invariant id, but only the owner produces certification credit. AIO-835 Phase 0.

INT-001.title: One canonical public implementation per provider operation; no deep import or copied client.

INT-002.title: The manifest is the sole capability and route registry; provider names are not repeated in independent registries.

INT-003.title: Unsupported, ambiguous, stale, and conflict results are typed and distinguishable from verified success.

INT-004.title: Directional blockers preserve source and target exactly; symmetric related links match in either order.

INT-005.title: Removal of an absent relation is an idempotent no-op.

INT-006.title: Every successful mutation is read back and verified against stable identity and requested fields.

INT-007.title: Mutations are never blindly retried; retry requires a provider idempotency key or a preflight/readback strategy proving duplicate safety.

INT-008.title: Pagination is complete or returns an explicit declared truncation outcome; it never silently truncates.

INT-009.title: Provider rate-limit units are normalized before time comparison and bounded backoff honors provider reset windows.

INT-010.title: Credential source is deterministic and every surface is redacted; secrets are references, never manifest values.

INT-011.title: Tenant and member isolation: team_id and member identity derive from authenticated server context and every query carries a tenant predicate.

INT-012.title: OAuth state and webhook signature, expiry, replay, and ordering behavior are enforced over the raw body.

INT-013.title: Paths are canonicalized before containment checks and subprocesses use argument arrays with trusted executable resolution.

INT-014.title: Provenance and projection fingerprints prevent echo loops; unchanged normalized input performs no provider writes.

INT-015.title: Concurrent edits surface a typed conflict and are never silently overwritten.

INT-016.title: Parent-before-child hierarchy ordering is preserved and hierarchy cycles fail closed.

INT-017.title: Access tier and audience can only become more restrictive on ingest, and provider rich text is sanitized before rendering, indexing, logging, or model context assembly.

INT-018.title: Install, upgrade, and uninstall are atomic or recoverable; partial installation is reported as unhealthy.

INT-019.title: Contract and Harness policy compatibility fails closed for missing, malformed, and future-major versions.

INT-020.title: Live sandbox inventory reaches zero active prefixed objects and the disposable credential is revoked and probed.
